title: Zions Bank Breaks Ground for New Branch in New Plymouth
summary: Zions Bank President and CEO Nate Callister broke ground Jan. 22 for a new branch in New Plymouth.
body_markdown:
NEW PLYMOUTH, Idaho; Jan. 22, 2026 — Zions Bank President and CEO Nate Callister along with New Plymouth Mayor Tyson Flannery and community members broke ground Jan. 22 for a new branch in New Plymouth.


Located at 330 N. Plymouth Ave., the new 2,156-square-foot branch will replace the bank’s current location at 130 N. Plymouth Ave. and will provide more space and amenities for clients. The new location will feature three offices, a full-service drive‑up teller lane for client transactions, a drive-up ATM, and a night depository. The branch was designed by Prescott Muir Architects and Layton Construction Co. will serve as general contractor. Construction is scheduled for completion in August.


“New Plymouth has a strong sense of community and a bright future,” said New Plymouth Branch Manager Carla Johanek. “We’re investing in the future by providing the space and resources to support local families and businesses as they grow and thrive.”


Until the new branch opens, Zions Bank’s current location will continue to offer consumer banking, small business and commercial lending, treasury management and residential mortgage services to help local businesses and individuals reach their financial goals.


“Breaking ground on this new branch underscores our commitment not just to Idaho, but to its rural communities,” said Nate Callister, Zions Bank President and CEO. “Expertise serving businesses, agricultural producers and individuals has been a hallmark of Zions Bank for more than 150 years.”


**About Zions Bank**


Zions Bank, a division of Zions Bancorporation, N.A. Member FDIC, operates 25 branches in Idaho and 94 branches in Utah and Wyoming. In addition to offering a wide range of traditional banking services, Zions Bank is also a leader in small business lending. Founded in 1873, Zions Bank has been serving the communities of the Intermountain West for more than 150 years. Additional information is available atwww.zionsbank.com .
